ns2:course.label: Dance History II
ns2:course.description: Survey of critical approaches in dance studies including feminist theory, poststructural, and postcolonial theory, historiography, and ethnographic research methods. Course topics will cover a variety of theatrical, popular, and social dance practices. Course may be repeated to a maximum of 6 undergraduate hours and 9 graduate hours. Prerequisite: DANC 440 or permission of the instructor.
